shortDescription: Manage AppRole roles in HashiCorp Vault

options.name: bind_secret_id
options.description: Whether a SecretID is required to authenticate.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for TLS client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, C(client_key) is not required.

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for TLS client authentication. If C(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs.

options.name: mount_point
options.description: Path where the backend is mounted.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the role to manage.

options.name: secret_id_bound_cidrs
options.description: CIDR blocks that are allowed to authenticate.

options.name: secret_id_num_uses
options.description: Number of times any particular SecretID can be used to authenticate. C(0) is unlimited.

options.name: secret_id_ttl
options.description: Duration in seconds after which a SecretID expires.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the role.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Request timeout, in seconds.

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token to use. If this is not set then the contents of C(~/.vault-token) will be checked.

options.name: token_bound_cidrs
options.description: CIDR blocks that are allowed to authenticate. The resulting token will also be tied to these blocks.

options.name: token_explicit_max_ttl
options.description: Explicit max TTL for generated tokens. This is a hard cap even if I(token_ttl) and I(token_max_ttl) would still allow a renewal.

options.name: token_max_ttl
options.description: The maximum lifetime for generated tokens.

options.name: token_no_default_policy
options.description: Disable adding the default policy to generated tokens. Normally this policy is added in addition to the explicit policies in I(token_policies).

options.name: token_num_uses
options.description: The maximum number of times a generated token can be used. C(0) is unlimited. If this is set to a non-zero value the token will not be able to create child tokens.

options.name: token_period
options.description: The period to set on the token.

options.name: token_policies
options.description: List of policies to add to generated tokens. Depending on the auth method, this list may be supplemented by user/group/other values.

options.name: token_ttl
options.description: The incremental lifetime for renewed tokens.

options.name: token_type
options.description: Type of token that should be returned. C(default) uses the setting from the mount.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), TLS certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vault_addr
options.description: Location of the Vault service.
